events.text: The seventh month: the gates of the underworld open and the dead walk among the living.

choices.text: Leave food out for wandering spirits

effects.log: Politeness costs nothing.
Everyone does this month.

events.text: The old people list the rules: no whistling at night, no swimming, no moving house, no calling names in the dark.

effects.log: Nothing strange happens to you.
You whistle at night. Something whistles back.

events.text: At the opera stage, the front row is left empty: for the ghosts.

effects.log: The actors bow to the empty seats.
You feel a chill from the front row all night.

events.text: At night someone calls your name from the river.

effects.log: The old rule: never answer a voice in the dark.

ok.log: It is a lost friend, who fell in and needed help.

fail.log: Nobody is there. You are cold for a week.

events.text: Shops close early. Streets fill with offerings: rice, fruit, paper money.

choices.text: Make an offering for the forgotten dead

effects.log: Those with no family to remember them.

choices.text: Help an old woman carry her offerings

effects.log: She tells you about her husband.

events.text: A 'ghost hunter' charges villagers to remove ghosts.

effects.log: He is chased out.
Very dramatic. Very fake.

events.text: A wandering fighter claims to be the ghost of a famous swordsman and challenges you.

ok.log: Very much alive. He admits it and laughs.

fail.log: Ghost or not, he is good.

choices.text: Offer him food like a hungry ghost

effects.log: He eats it happily. Ghosts eat a lot.

events.text: A woman says her dead son visits her in dreams asking for his sword.

choices.text: Help her bury his sword with him

effects.log: She dreams of him smiling.
A memory she can hold.

events.text: You are told not to go out at night this month. Of course you want to.

effects.log: Wise child.
A cat. Definitely a cat.

events.text: An old road where spirits are said to walk in the seventh month.

effects.log: Nothing but birdsong. And a feeling.
For travellers who never arrived.

events.text: The village gathers for ghost stories under the full moon.

effects.log: A child screams. A grandmother nods approvingly.
You sleep with the lamp on.

events.text: An old beggar who sheltered by your door at the start of the month thanks you on the last night, and is gone by morning, leaving no footprints.

effects.log: Some guests are not quite of this world.
You never know.
